scenes.title: Previously: the RAG pipeline
flow: A file hit isn't an answer

captions.text: Recap of chapter 20: we cut 95 files into chunks, because they don't fit in a prompt.
Rag searches once, puts five hits in the prompt, and asks the model once.
The file hit rate checks for the right file. That isn't the right answer.
Whole files with room did as well. Chunks saved tokens, and they lost something.
Today: one repair to the chunks, measured.
It'll work, and it'll cost something.
How long was the Station card reader down? The fact is in the index.
Predict: will the right file come back? Will the answer be right?
The right file came first. The file hit says 1 of 1.
And the model says it doesn't know, on all five runs.
Don't guess. Print the chunk that holds the fact.
The answer is here: 07:40 to 11:15. But the word Station isn't.
Nor is its date. The only date is the next day's heading, left at the bottom.
So it ranked 111th of 934. Whole files never lost those words. Chunking did.
The file hit couldn't see this, so we add a second ruler: text found.
A hit counts only if it's from a right file, and its text holds the answer.
Fix one. Take the file's first line, and put it on top of each chunk.
Predict: it ranked 111th, and we've added one line. Where will it rank now?
First. One line gave the chunk "Station" and "December 2025".
Now the answers: 42 questions, three runs each. Each setup runs twice.
plain60 against itself moved 4 points. So look for more than that.
With titles, the total didn't rise. A fix that worked can hide in a total.
Records rose to 21, twice. But gap fell. One question broke.
The footwear question went from 6 of 6 to 0 of 6, with the right chunk still first.
Alone, the right chunk passes 5 of 5. Add two neighbors, and it's 0 of 5.
A chunk competes with everything around it. We don't know why this model reacts so.
Next, a bigger chunk size. Records reach 24 of 24, twice.
But gap fell to 15, twice. It gained in one place, and lost in another.
Bigger chunks kept the Tidewater heading by luck. It isn't a repair.
Read what's left. e44 and fn6: the search missed. That's chapter 22.
hop needs two facts, and one search brings one. That's chapter 23.
mice, shoes and tidewater: the text was in the prompt, and the answer was still wrong.
Your turn. Open exercises.py and complete the five TODOs.
You'll cut at headings, and put titles on every chunk. No Ollama needed.
You've finished when you see 5 passed.

scenes.title: You opened better chunks.
points: A fix can break something else
Read the rows, not the total

captions.text: The fix worked, and it cost something. Now you can tell which.
Next, the search itself, for what it still misses.
